reviewed_by: Claude Code, after confirming the root cause (release N raised CorruptRecordError on rows with N+1 fields) with an independent validation subagent
reason: Stored-entity decoding now tolerates unknown keys a newer release wrote and keeps them on rewrite, with a two-way rolling-release gate and an entity-field digest. Selected: the new test_tolerant_entity_readers.py (SQLite + PostgreSQL: unknown-key reads, every update path keeps keys, list-item anchoring by id and by content, copies do not inherit, input/changes stay strict, union refusal, coordinator gate both directions, digest guard); storage contracts (test_async_storage, test_async_postgresql, test_entity_hot_lookups, test_turn_write_amplification, test_startup_unreadable_rows, test_recovery_candidate_scan); deployment gate neighbours (test_deployment_lifecycle, test_storage_report_compatibility, test_mixed_release_idle_retirement, test_butler_home_scope, test_runtime_bundle); rewrite paths (test_relations, test_operators); converted readers (test_file_attribution, test_runtime_global_project_reads). ci.yml adds the new test to the selected-PostgreSQL gates.
exclusions: No API shape, UI, setting or operator workflow change, so no frontend, Playwright, settings-assistant or LAN-instance journey applies. The ~40 mechanical decode_stored call-site swaps behave exactly like model_validate for valid rows (same ValidationError otherwise), so their large module suites (test_harnesses, test_chat, Butler suites) are not selected. Event payloads and host-call bodies are out of scope. Locally test_recovery_journey_on_authenticated_lan_core fails only because this host's name resolves to 127.0.1.1 (it requires a LAN address).
